papers.title: Global Excess Maternal Mortality During the COVID-19 Pandemic: Country-Level Counterfactual Estimates and Associated Factors
papers.translated_title: 新冠疫情期间全球超额孕产妇死亡：国家层面的反事实估计及相关因素
papers.author: Gajjar, J. H.
papers.summary: Background: COVID-19 increased maternal risk through infection and disruption of essential services, but maternal mortality was already changing before 2020, making simple pre-pandemic comparisons difficult. Objectives: To estimate country-level departures in maternal deaths and maternal mortality ratios (MMR) during 2020-2023 from projected pre-pandemic trajectories and examine whether maternal health-service disruptions were associated with MMR deviations. Methods: We fitted country-specific counterfactual models to WHO/UN MMEIG estimates from 2000-2019 and projected maternal deaths and MMR through 2023 under a no-pandemic scenario. Excess was defined as the positive difference between the MMEIG estimate and counterfactual value. In a self-selected subset of 39 countries (63 country-year observations), we modelled log(MMEIG-estimated MMR/counterfactual MMR) as a function of three service-disruption measures and four baseline or year covariates. Results: Across 195 countries and territories, cumulative excess maternal deaths were estimated at 68,489 (95% UI 34,706, 147,118); 113 had statistically detectable cumulative excess. The largest regional burdens were in South-East Asia, the Eastern Mediterranean, and Africa. In the 39-country subset, antenatal care, facility-based delivery, and postnatal care disruption were not clearly associated with signed MMR deviation in the full or separate models. No single country materially changed the estimated coefficients in leave-one-country-out analyses, and excluding Namibia, which had the two most unusual observations, did not alter the conclusions. Conclusions: Maternal mortality departed substantially but unevenly from pre-pandemic trajectories. The absence of associations with broad national disruption measures should not be interpreted as evidence that service disruption was unimportant; it instead highlights the need for more detailed measures of service access and quality, alongside protection of the maternal-care continuum during emergencies.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：COVID-19通过感染和基本服务中断增加了孕产妇风险，但孕产妇死亡率在2020年之前就已发生变化，这使得简单的大流行前比较变得困难。目标：估算2020-2023年期间各国孕产妇死亡数和孕产妇死亡率比（MMR）相对于大流行前预测轨迹的偏离，并检验孕产妇卫生服务中断是否与MMR偏差相关。方法：我们对WHO/UN MMEIG 2000-2019年估算值拟合了各国特定的反事实模型，并在无大流行情景下预测了截至2023年的孕产妇死亡数和MMR。超额定义为MMEIG估算值与反事实值之间的正差。在一个自选的39个国家子集（63个国家-年观测值）中，我们将log（MMEIG估算MMR/反事实MMR）建模为三个服务中断指标和四个基线或年份协变量的函数。结果：在195个国家和地区中，累计超额孕产妇死亡数估计为68,489（95% UI 34,706, 147,118）；其中113个国家具有统计学上可检测的累计超额。区域负担最大的是东南亚、东地中海和非洲。在39国子集中，产前保健、机构分娩和产后保健中断在完整模型或单独模型中与有符号MMR偏差均无明确关联。在逐一剔除国家的分析中，没有任何单一国家实质性改变估计系数，并且剔除拥有两个最异常观测值的纳米比亚也未改变结论。结论：孕产妇死亡率相对于大流行前轨迹出现了显著但不均衡的偏离。与广泛的国家层面中断指标缺乏关联，不应被解释为服务中断不重要的证据；相反，这凸显了需要更详细的服务可及性和质量指标，同时在紧急情况下保护孕产妇保健连续体。

papers.title: Diffusion MRI abnormalities localise the epileptogenic zone in paediatric drug-resistant epilepsy
papers.translated_title: 扩散磁共振成像异常可定位儿童耐药性癫痫的致痫区
papers.author: Veljanoski, D.
papers.summary: Objectives: Seizure freedom follows surgery in 67% of children with drug-resistant epilepsy, but imaging biomarkers could improve patient selection, epileptogenic zone localisation, and outcome prediction. We assessed whether diffusion MRI abnormalities predicted seizure freedom when resected; aligned with stereo-EEG seizure-onset and interictal zones; distinguished patients with/without an identified onset zone; and localised the epileptogenic zone in MRI-negative cases. Methods: We retrospectively studied children undergoing focal resection (n=110) or stereo-EEG (n=61) between 2015-2023, alongside healthy controls aged 6-18 (n=69), using identical 3T MRI diffusion protocols. Age- and sex-adjusted normative models generated mean diffusivity (MD) and fractional anisotropy (FA) voxelwise z-score maps to identify dominant abnormalities. In resection patients, abnormality-resection overlap was related to 12-month or longer Engel outcome. In stereo-EEG patients, z-scores were compared across seizure-onset, interictal, and uninvolved grey-matter contacts. In lesion-negative patients, abnormalities were compared with PET hypometabolism and stereo-EEG findings. Results: Greater resection of MD abnormalities predicted seizure freedom, especially with overlap >0 (mean differences 17%, 23%; Pperm=0.0086, <0.001), and higher odds of Engel I (OR 1.31/10%; AUC 0.723; Youden threshold 36%). FA showed similar associations. Seizure-onset contacts had higher MD and lower FA z-scores than uninvolved grey matter (+0.65, 0.18; Pperm<0.001, =0.001), with interictal contacts intermediate. Abnormalities were more widespread and contralateral in patients without an identified onset zone. In lesion-negative patients, abnormalities co-localised with PET (20/28 fully, 6/28 partially) and stereo-EEG (17/24 fully, 3/24 partially). Interpretation: Diffusion MRI abnormalities aligned with invasive electrophysiology, predicted seizure freedom when resected, and co-localized with PET/stereo-EEG, supporting an important role in presurgical evaluation.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：67%的耐药性癫痫患儿在手术后实现无发作，但影像生物标志物可改善患者选择、致痫区定位和预后预测。我们评估了扩散MRI异常在被切除时是否能预测无发作；是否与立体脑电图（stereo-EEG）发作起始区和发作间期区一致；是否能区分有/无明确发作起始区的患者；以及在MRI阴性病例中是否能定位致痫区。方法：我们回顾性研究了2015至2023年间接受局灶性切除术（n=110）或立体脑电图（n=61）的儿童，以及6至18岁的健康对照者（n=69），使用相同的3T MRI扩散协议。年龄和性别校正的规范模型生成体素水平的平均弥散率（MD）和各向异性分数（FA）z分数图，以识别主要异常。在切除患者中，异常与切除区域的重叠与12个月或更长的Engel结局相关。在立体脑电图患者中，比较发作起始、发作间期和未受累灰质触点的z分数。在病变阴性患者中，将异常与PET低代谢和立体脑电图结果进行比较。结果：MD异常切除范围越大越能预测无发作，尤其是重叠>0时（平均差异17%、23%；Pperm=0.0086、<0.001），且Engel I的几率更高（OR 1.31/10%；AUC 0.723；Youden阈值36%）。FA显示类似关联。发作起始触点的MD z分数高于未受累灰质，FA z分数低于未受累灰质（+0.65、0.18；Pperm<0.001、=0.001），发作间期触点居中。在无明确发作起始区的患者中，异常更广泛且位于对侧。在病变阴性患者中，异常与PET共定位（20/28完全，6/28部分）并与立体脑电图共定位（17/24完全，3/24部分）。解读：扩散MRI异常与侵入性电生理一致，在被切除时预测无发作，并与PET/立体脑电图共定位，支持其在术前评估中的重要作用。

papers.title: Investigating laboratory capacity and whole genome sequencing practices to inform standardised protocols for bacterial genomic surveillance in Africa.
papers.translated_title: 调查实验室能力和全基因组测序实践，为非洲细菌基因组监测的标准化方案提供依据。
papers.author: Fortuin, C.
papers.summary: Sepsis is a substantial contributor to neonatal mortality in Africa, with Klebsiella pneumoniae as the leading causative pathogen. Incorporating molecular tools such as whole genome sequencing (WGS) into routine surveillance of important bacterial pathogens, including those causing neonatal sepsis, can support targeted deployment of infection prevention and control measures and treatment interventions. This study aimed to understand the current practices and capacity for culture, identification and genomic analysis of bacterial pathogens in Africa, with a particular focus on K. pneumoniae, to support standardised genomic surveillance. A cross-sectional online survey was distributed to various clinician and scientist networks across Africa. All respondents completed a demographics section, while sections on laboratory test capacity, blood culture practices, WGS, and bioinformatics analysis were completed based on experience in these aspects. Responses were received from 52 institutions in 25 African countries. Among 51 institutions completing the laboratory test capacity section, 61% reported performing blood cultures, with the majority using manual commercial biochemical systems for species identification (71%) and manual disk diffusion for antibiotic susceptibility testing (82%). Participating institutions reported near-universal access to a -80{degrees}C freezer, centrifuge and thermocycler, but shaking incubators were less commonly available (67%). More than half of respondents (54%) indicated that they perform the entire WGS workflow (including DNA extraction, library preparation and WGS) internally, with most performing DNA extraction internally (88%) using column-based kits (70%). Outsourcing was progressively more common at later workflow stages. Infrastructure challenges that limit bioinformatics analysis capabilities were reported by all 23 respondents who completed this question, including limited access to high-performance computing and data storage space. This survey found sufficient capacity to support genomic surveillance of neonatal sepsis pathogens across participating African institutions. However, investments in blood culture, supply chains, sequencing, bioinformatics, and data dissemination capacity are needed to realise its full potential. These findings will support the development of standardised genomic surveillance protocols tailored to the diverse capacities of African laboratories.
papers.translated_summary: 脓毒症是非洲新生儿死亡的重要原因，其中肺炎克雷伯菌是主要致病病原体。将全基因组测序（WGS）等分子工具纳入重要细菌病原体（包括引起新生儿脓毒症的病原体）的常规监测，可支持有针对性地部署感染预防与控制措施和治疗干预。本研究旨在了解非洲当前在细菌病原体培养、鉴定和基因组分析方面的实践和能力，特别关注肺炎克雷伯菌，以支持标准化基因组监测。我们向非洲各地的多个临床医生和科学家网络分发了一项横断面在线调查。所有受访者均完成了人口统计学部分，而实验室检测能力、血培养实践、WGS和生物信息学分析部分则根据在这些方面的经验完成。共收到来自25个非洲国家52家机构的回复。在完成实验室检测能力部分的51家机构中，61%报告开展血培养，大多数使用手动商业生化系统进行菌种鉴定（71%），并使用手动纸片扩散法进行抗生素敏感性检测（82%）。参与机构报告几乎普遍可获得-80°C冰箱、离心机和热循环仪，但振荡培养箱的可用性较低（67%）。超过半数受访者（54%）表示其在内部完成整个WGS工作流程（包括DNA提取、文库制备和WGS），大多数在内部进行DNA提取（88%），并使用柱式试剂盒（70%）。在后续工作流程阶段，外包逐渐更为常见。所有完成该问题的23名受访者均报告了限制生物信息学分析能力的基础设施挑战，包括获得高性能计算和数据存储空间的机会有限。本调查发现，参与研究的非洲机构具备足够能力支持新生儿脓毒症病原体的基因组监测。然而，要充分发挥其潜力，仍需在血培养、供应链、测序、生物信息学和数据传播能力方面进行投资。这些发现将支持制定适合非洲实验室多样能力的标准化基因组监测方案。

papers.title: No Heavy Drinking Days and Percentage of Days Abstinent in a Randomized Trial of Adjunctive Ketamine for Alcohol Use Disorder: Secondary Analysis of the KARE Trial
papers.translated_title: 无重度饮酒日与戒酒天数百分比：一项关于辅助性氯胺酮治疗酒精使用障碍的随机试验：KARE试验的二次分析
papers.author: Morgan, C. J.
papers.summary: In the KARE trial, 96 adults with severe alcohol use disorder, abstinent following detoxification, were randomised in a 2x2 factorial design to 3 weekly infusions of ketamine (0.8 mg/kg) or saline, each combined with mindfulness-based psychological support (PS) or alcohol psychoeducation (PE). We re-expressed the trial data on endpoints acceptable to regulators and compared the most and least intensive arms. Across pooled weeks 17-24, ketamine plus PS gave 78.5% versus 57.8% days abstinent (difference, 20.7 percentage points; P = .032); adjusted for baseline, the difference at weeks 21-24 was 26.9 percentage points (P = .011). At weeks 21-24, 50.0% versus 26.1% had no heavy drinking days (P = .127). Relative reductions in heavy drinking days were 55% in KARE, against 25%, -17%, 46% and 35% reported for naltrexone, exenatide, semaglutide and pemvidutide. These post hoc differences, measured 4 to 6 months after a 4 week course ended, are of magnitude similar to agents requiring continuous administration.
papers.translated_summary: 在KARE试验中，96名在脱毒后保持戒断的重度酒精使用障碍成人被随机分配至2x2析因设计，接受每周3次氯胺酮（0.8 mg/kg）或生理盐水输注，每种输注均联合基于正念的心理支持（PS）或酒精心理教育（PE）。我们以监管机构可接受的终点重新表达了试验数据，并比较了干预强度最高和最低的两个组。在合并的第17-24周，氯胺酮联合PS组的戒酒天数为78.5%，而对照组为57.8%（差异为20.7个百分点；P = .032）；经基线校正后，第21-24周的差异为26.9个百分点（P = .011）。在第21-24周，50.0%对26.1%的受试者没有重度饮酒日（P = .127）。KARE中重度饮酒日的相对减少为55%，而纳曲酮、艾塞那肽、司美格鲁肽和pemvidutide报告的数据分别为25%、-17%、46%和35%。这些事后差异是在为期4周的疗程结束4至6个月后测量的，其幅度与需要持续给药的药物相似。

papers.title: Feasibility of PI-RADS Compliant Prostate MRI at 0.55T
papers.translated_title: 符合PI-RADS标准的前列腺MRI在0.55T下的可行性
papers.author: Spencer, A. P. C.
papers.summary: Purpose: To demonstrate the feasibility of prostate MRI at low-field and provide an optimised low-field prostate MRI protocol. Methods: In 15 healthy male volunteers (mean age 62 years, 95% CI 57-68) and 22 patients with suspected prostate cancer (mean age 68 years, 95% CI 64-71), we acquired bi-parametric prostate MRI at 0.55T including tri-planar T2-weighted imaging (WI) and axial diffusion weighted imaging (DWI). Parameters adhered to PI-RADS guidelines and deep learning reconstruction (DLR) was used to enhance image quality. In healthy volunteers, we optimised the protocol based on evaluation of SNR, CNR and qualitative image scores. In patients, we evaluated qualitative image scores and lesion detection performance using 3T as the reference. Results: The acquisition time (minutes:seconds) was 4:02 for axial T2-WI and 6:32 for DWI. In healthy controls, DLR substantially improved T2-WI quality (p<0.05). The optimised DWI protocol had b-values of 50 and 800 s mm-2, with a calculated b-value image at 1500 s mm-2. Twenty-one patients (95%), and all controls, had at least acceptable diagnostic quality (PI-QUAL score[≥]2/3) at low-field MRI. With respect to the 3T reference, two readers detected lesions at low-field with sensitivity of 79% and 75% at the lesion level. At the patient level, the sensitivity was 91% for both readers. Low-field patient-level lesion detection did not significantly differ from 3T (p=0.5). Conclusion: Prostate MRI is feasible at low-field, providing clinically acceptable acquisition times for diagnostic quality images with comparable patient-level lesion detection performance to 3T.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：论证低场前列腺MRI的可行性，并提供优化的低场前列腺MRI方案。方法：在15名健康男性志愿者（平均年龄62岁，95% CI 57-68）和22名疑似前列腺癌患者（平均年龄68岁，95% CI 64-71）中，我们在0.55T下采集了双参数前列腺MRI，包括三平面T2加权成像（WI）和轴位扩散加权成像（DWI）。参数遵循PI-RADS指南，并使用深度学习重建（DLR）以提高图像质量。在健康志愿者中，我们基于SNR、CNR和定性图像评分的评估优化了方案。在患者中，我们以3T作为参考，评估了定性图像评分和病灶检测性能。结果：轴位T2-WI的采集时间（分:秒）为4:02，DWI为6:32。在健康对照中，DLR显著改善了T2-WI质量（p<0.05）。优化后的DWI方案b值为50和800 s mm-2，并计算得到1500 s mm-2的b值图像。21名患者（95%）和所有对照在低场MRI下均具有至少可接受的诊断质量（PI-QUAL评分≥2/3）。相对于3T参考，两名阅片者在低场下于病灶水平检测病灶的敏感性分别为79%和75%。在患者水平，两名阅片者的敏感性均为91%。低场患者水平病灶检测与3T无显著差异（p=0.5）。结论：前列腺MRI在低场下可行，能够以临床可接受的采集时间获得诊断质量图像，并且患者水平病灶检测性能与3T相当。

papers.title: A ReAct Agentic AI System for Natural Language Querying and Statistical Analysis of The Cancer Genome Atlas Clinical Data
papers.translated_title: 一个用于自然语言查询和统计分析癌症基因组图谱临床数据的ReAct智能体AI系统
papers.author: Korutla, R.
papers.summary: The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) holds clinical data for over 11,000 patients across 33 cancer types, but access is hard because of complex file structures, heterogeneous formats, and the need for programming. We present an agentic system for natural language querying and statistical analysis of TCGA clinical data. The system uses a large language model as an autonomous ReAct agent that selects from eight computational tools, including data extraction, descriptive statistics, Kaplan-Meier survival analysis with log-rank tests, hypothesis testing, and verification against the curated TCGA Pan-Cancer Clinical Data Resource (CDR). The agent reasons about intermediate results, adapts its approach, and returns clinically contextualized responses with source attribution and auditable traces. We introduce TCGA-Agent-Bench, 440 queries across five difficulty tiers with ground truth from the independently curated TCGA-CDR, evaluated with dual metrics of numerical accuracy and clinical completeness. The system achieves 93.4% overall accuracy (100% single-patient lookups, 99.1% cohort statistics, 92.8% comparative analyses), outperforming a fixed rule-based pipeline (87.1%), a single-pass LLM (81.8%), and retrieval-augmented generation (66.9% on a subset). Most of the benchmark is answerable from the CDR alone, so we locate the extraction layer's value in fields the CDR lacks (drug treatments, TNM components, biomarkers, biospecimen metadata): on 26 queries targeting these, the full system answers 100% versus 3.8% for CDR-only. Ablations show the reasoning loop is most impactful (+9.1% accuracy, +22.0 completeness points). A tool-based agentic architecture enables accurate, auditable analysis of clinical repositories, with value driven by tool design and recovered fields rather than model scale.
papers.translated_summary: 癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）保存了涵盖33种癌症类型、超过11000名患者的临床数据，但由于文件结构复杂、格式异质以及需要编程，访问这些数据十分困难。我们提出了一种用于TCGA临床数据自然语言查询与统计分析的智能体系统。该系统使用大语言模型作为自主ReAct智能体，从八种计算工具中进行选择，包括数据提取、描述性统计、带对数秩检验的Kaplan-Meier生存分析、假设检验，以及对照精心整理的TCGA泛癌临床数据资源（CDR）进行验证。该智能体对中间结果进行推理，调整其方法，并返回具有临床语境化的响应，附带来源归属和可审计轨迹。我们提出了TCGA-Agent-Bench，包含跨越五个难度层级的440个查询，其真值来自独立整理的TCGA-CDR，并以数值准确性和临床完整性双重指标进行评估。该系统达到93.4%的总体准确率（单患者查询100%，队列统计99.1%，比较分析92.8%），优于固定规则流水线（87.1%）、单次LLM（81.8%）以及检索增强生成（在子集上为66.9%）。该基准的大部分内容仅凭CDR即可回答，因此我们将提取层的价值定位于CDR所缺乏的字段（药物治疗、TNM组成部分、生物标志物、生物样本元数据）：在针对这些内容的26个查询上，完整系统回答率为100%，而仅使用CDR为3.8%。消融实验表明，推理循环影响最大（准确率+9.1%，完整性+22.0个百分点）。基于工具的智能体架构能够对临床存储库进行准确、可审计的分析，其价值由工具设计和恢复的字段驱动，而非模型规模。

papers.title: Left Ventricular Volume and Function Assessment Using a Reduced-Slice Approach in Cardiovascular Magnetic Resonance
papers.translated_title: 使用减少切片方法在心血管磁共振中评估左心室容量和功能
papers.author: Tejaswi, A.
papers.summary: Object: To test the hypothesis that a reduced-slice geometric model can maintain left ventricular (LV) volumetry, thereby providing a rapid and reliable clinical alternative to conventional full-stack planimetry. Materials and Methods: In a retrospective cohort of 342 patients with full-stack cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR), nine geometric combinations (3, 4, or 5 short-axis (SAx) slices and a 2, 3, or 4 chambered long-axis (LAx) slice) were evaluated by decimating the original acquisitions. Volumes were calculated using trapezoidal mid-cavity approximations and a generalized prismoidal model for the basal region. This was compared to the full-stack reference using concordance correlation coefficient (CCC), repeated measures ANOVA, pairwise tests and Bayes factor log10(BF10) analysis. Results: The choice of LAx view influenced the accuracy approximately 50 times more than SAx slice count. For a 2ch + 5 SAx protocol, EF bias was just 0.83% (LoA: -6.18 to 7.84%), with a minimum detectable change (MDC) of 7.01%, compared to 8.7% reported for expert human readers, suggesting strong concordance (CCC>0.90) with full-stack. Bayesian analysis decisively supported 5 over 3 SAx slices (log10(BF10) = 6.42). Conclusion: This proposed model successfully minimizes scan time and breath-holds while maintaining clinical accuracy. Functional metric bias remains lower than scan-rescan variability. Keywords: Left Ventricle; Volumetry; Stroke Volume; Ejection Fraction; Scan Time Reduction; Global Function
papers.translated_summary: 目的：检验一种减少层数的几何模型能否维持左心室（LV）容积测量，从而为传统全层堆叠平面测量法提供一种快速、可靠的临床替代方案。材料与方法：在一项纳入342例患者的全层堆叠心血管磁共振（CMR）回顾性队列中，通过抽取原始采集数据，评估了九种几何组合（3、4或5层短轴（SAx）切面，以及2、3或4腔长轴（LAx）切面）。容积采用梯形中腔近似法和基底区域的广义棱柱模型计算。使用一致性相关系数（CCC）、重复测量方差分析、成对检验和贝叶斯因子log10(BF10)分析，将其与全层堆叠参考值进行比较。结果：LAx视图的选择对准确性的影响约为SAx层数的50倍。对于2ch + 5 SAx方案，EF偏倚仅为0.83%（LoA：-6.18至7.84%），最小可检测变化（MDC）为7.01%，而据报道，专业人类读者为8.7%，提示与全层堆叠具有强一致性（CCC>0.90）。贝叶斯分析明确支持5层优于3层SAx切面（log10(BF10) = 6.42）。结论：所提出的模型成功地将扫描时间和屏气次数降至最低，同时保持临床准确性。功能指标偏倚仍低于扫描-重扫描变异性。关键词：左心室；容积测量；每搏输出量；射血分数；扫描时间缩短；整体功能

papers.title: Exploring multifaceted mental resilience from the perspectives of sleep and circadian rhythm in healthy adults
papers.translated_title: 从睡眠和昼夜节律的角度探索健康成年人多层面的心理韧性
papers.author: Chen, C. X.
papers.summary: Background: Emerging evidence suggested the role of sleep and circadian rhythm in the development of mental resilience, but the association of an integrated analysis of objective sleep and circadian measures with multifaceted mental resilience in healthy adults has been underexplored. Objective: This study aims to explore the associations between multifaceted mental resilience and sleep and circadian rhythm in healthy adults. Methods: A total of 156 healthy adults (Age: Mean (SD): 29.54 (5.28) years; 60.9% female) underwent 14-day actigraphy, one night polysomnography (PSG) and dim light melatonin onset (DLMO) assessments. Resilience was operationalized as both a coping capacity and a positive mental health outcome in the context of accumulative adversity (life stressful events and childhood adversities). We first identified the covariance patterns between multiple sleep and circadian health domains (Sleep macro- and microstructures, dim light melatonin onset, rest activity pattern) and multifaceted mental resilience using partial least squares regression (PLSR), and followed by univariate analysis as complementary to illustrate the distribution trends of sleep and circadian rhythm parameters across integrative resilience score derived from principal component analysis (PCA). Findings: The PLSR model identified a modest but significant association of greater mental resilience with a sleep and circadian profile (Bootstrapping r = 0.15, 95%CI: 0.02-0.28), characterized by greater frontal-central slow waves activity in NREM sleep, greater frontal theta activity in REM sleep, lower occipital spectral power across fast and slow frequency bands in NREM and REM sleep, and probably earlier dim light melatonin onset timing. Conclusions: Sleep and circadian metrics, specifically frontal slow waves and REM theta activity, attenuated overall occipital spectral power during sleep, and earlier dim light melatonin onset time, represent quantifiable targets that may serve to improve resilience and stress-related mental health in adults. Longitudinal and interventional studies are needed to establish whether sleep interventions can be endorsed as evidence-based approaches for resilience enhancement. Clinical implications: Targeting sleep and circadian aspects may be an important approach to promote stress-related mental health.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：新出现的证据表明睡眠和昼夜节律在心理韧性发展中发挥作用，但客观睡眠与昼夜节律指标的综合分析与健康成年人多维度心理韧性之间的关联尚未得到充分探索。目的：本研究旨在探讨健康成年人多维度心理韧性与睡眠及昼夜节律之间的关联。方法：共纳入156名健康成年人（年龄：均值（标准差）：29.54（5.28）岁；60.9%为女性），接受14天活动记录仪、一晚多导睡眠图（PSG）和暗光褪黑素起始（DLMO）评估。韧性被操作化为在累积逆境（生活压力事件和童年逆境）背景下的应对能力和积极心理健康结局。我们首先使用偏最小二乘回归（PLSR）识别多个睡眠和昼夜节律健康领域（睡眠宏观和微观结构、暗光褪黑素起始、静息活动模式）与多维度心理韧性之间的协变模式，随后进行单变量分析作为补充，以说明睡眠和昼夜节律参数在基于主成分分析（PCA）得出的综合韧性评分上的分布趋势。结果：PLSR模型识别出较高的心理韧性与一种睡眠和昼夜节律特征之间存在适度但显著的关联（Bootstrap r = 0.15，95%CI：0.02-0.28），该特征表现为NREM睡眠中额中央区慢波活动更强、REM睡眠中额区theta活动更强、NREM和REM睡眠中枕区快慢频段频谱功率总体较低，以及可能更早的暗光褪黑素起始时间。结论：睡眠和昼夜节律指标，特别是额区慢波和REM theta活动、睡眠期间枕区总体频谱功率减弱以及更早的暗光褪黑素起始时间，代表了可量化的靶点，可能有助于改善成年人的韧性和压力相关心理健康。需要纵向和干预性研究来确定睡眠干预是否可以被认可为增强韧性的循证方法。临床意义：针对睡眠和昼夜节律方面可能是促进压力相关心理健康的重要途径。

papers.title: Pre-treatment EEG microstates and response to antipsychotic drugs in first episode psychosis
papers.translated_title: 首发精神病抗精神病药物反应与治疗前脑电微状态
papers.author: Rubio, J. M.
papers.summary: Background and Hypothesis: First-line antipsychotics are ineffective in ~40% of people with first episode psychosis (FEP). Electroencephalogram (EEG)-based predictive biomarkers could be a scalable solution to reduce trial-and-error. Study Design: We acquired EEG in 56 minimally treated FEP individuals before treatment initiation, and 34 matched healthy controls (HC). Treatment response was defined as >50% improvement in BPRS scores by 12 weeks of treatment. Modified k-means clustering of resting-state EEG yielded six microstates including canonical topographies (A-D). The first principal component (PC1) of microstate properties derived from HCs served as a normative reference onto which FEP patients were projected. Baseline PC1 was used to predict treatment response in adjusted regression analyses. To test stability of results, an independent dataset of HCs (n=92) was fitted using the same microstate solution and compared to our native HC dataset. PC1 scores derived from this independent normative dataset were also used for predicting response in FEP. Study Results: Individual microstates replicated established patient-control differences (e.g., higher presence of microstate C compared to D, p<0.001). PC1 explained 34.8% of variance. Baseline PC1 predicted subsequent treatment response (adjusted OR=0.63, p<0.001), yielding AUC=72.3% in leave-one-out cross-validation (pperm<0.001) when combined with clinical information. PC1 from our HC transported well to the second healthy control EEG dataset (n=92) (r=0.9,p<0.001; r=0.89,p<0.001 ). PC1 in FEP derived using PC1 weights from a second normative dataset also predicted response in FEP (OR=0.70, p=0.03). Conclusions: EEG microstate architecture differing from the expected norm is associated with lower odds of treatment response in FEP.
papers.translated_summary: 背景与假设：一线抗精神病药物对约40%的首发精神病（FEP）患者无效。基于脑电图（EEG）的预测性生物标志物可能是一种可扩展的解决方案，以减少试错。研究设计：我们在56名接受最低限度治疗的FEP个体开始治疗前采集了EEG，并纳入34名匹配的健康对照者（HC）。治疗应答定义为治疗12周后BPRS评分改善>50%。对静息态EEG进行改良k均值聚类，得到六个微状态，包括典型地形图（A-D）。从HC中提取的微状态属性的第一主成分（PC1）作为规范参考，并将FEP患者投影至其上。在调整后的回归分析中，使用基线PC1预测治疗应答。为检验结果的稳定性，使用相同的微状态解拟合一个独立的HC数据集（n=92），并与我们的本地HC数据集进行比较。来自该独立规范数据集的PC1评分也用于预测FEP的应答。研究结果：单个微状态复现了已确立的患者-对照差异（例如，与微状态D相比，微状态C的存在更高，p<0.001）。PC1解释了34.8%的方差。基线PC1预测了后续治疗应答（调整后OR=0.63，p<0.001），当与临床信息结合时，在留一法交叉验证中得出AUC=72.3%（pperm<0.001）。来自我们HC的PC1很好地迁移至第二个健康对照EEG数据集（n=92）（r=0.9，p<0.001；r=0.89，p<0.001）。使用来自第二个规范数据集的PC1权重推导出的FEP中的PC1，也预测了FEP的应答（OR=0.70，p=0.03）。结论：不同于预期规范的EEG微状态架构与FEP中较低的治疗应答几率相关。

papers.title: Effect of Vesicular Monoamine Transporter Type-2 Inhibitors on Motor Features in HD
papers.translated_title: 囊泡单胺转运体2型抑制剂对亨廷顿病运动特征的影响
papers.author: Halabi, N. M.
papers.summary: Background: Huntington's disease (HD) is an inherited neurodegenerative disorder primarily associated with motor and psychiatric manifestations. No disease-modifying treatment currently exists, with vesicular monoamine transporter type-2 inhibitors (VMAT2i's) being the only FDA-approved therapy for motor features in HD. Previous studies evaluated the antichorea effects of VMAT2i's but did not address its effects on non-choreiform features. Objectives: This study aimed to characterize the effect of VMAT2i's on hyperkinetic, hypokinetic and total hypokinetic subscores of the UHDRS motor assessment in patients with motor-manifest HD from the Enroll-HD research platform. Methods: Data from 622 participants were analyzed. Linear mixed effects models were constructed to compare the rates of change of choreiform and non-choreiform motor scores before and after the initiation of a VMAT2i. We calculated and plotted the direction, magnitude and significance of VMAT2i administration on the rates of change of motor subscores. A similar analysis was performed investigating the effect of antipsychotic medications on motor subscales in HD. Results: VMAT2i's reversed progression of hyperkinesis but significantly increased the rates of change in the hypokinetic and total hypokinetic subscores. Antipsychotics also displayed efficacy in reversing progression of chorea but did not significantly influence progression of hypokinesis. Conclusions: The initiation of VMAT2i's was associated with an improvement in hyperkinesis but was associated with worsening of other motor features of HD. Hypokinesis increases progressively in HD and is correlated with functional impairment and global decline. Therefore, the use of VMAT2i's to treat motor features in HD should be a nuanced decision, considering its multipronged impact.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：亨廷顿病（HD）是一种遗传性神经退行性疾病，主要与运动和精神表现相关。目前尚无疾病修饰治疗，囊泡单胺转运体2型抑制剂（VMAT2i）是唯一获FDA批准用于HD运动症状的治疗。既往研究评估了VMAT2i的抗舞蹈病效果，但未探讨其对非舞蹈样症状的影响。目的：本研究旨在表征VMAT2i对来自Enroll-HD研究平台的运动表现型HD患者UHDRS运动评估中多动、少动及总少动子评分的影响。方法：分析了622名参与者的数据。构建线性混合效应模型，比较VMAT2i启用前后舞蹈样和非舞蹈样运动评分的变化率。我们计算并绘制了VMAT2i给药对运动子评分变化率的方向、幅度和显著性。还进行了类似分析，探讨抗精神病药物对HD运动子量表的影响。结果：VMAT2i逆转了多动症的进展，但显著增加了少动及总少动子评分的变化率。抗精神病药物也显示出逆转舞蹈病进展的疗效，但未显著影响少动症的进展。结论：VMAT2i的启用与多动症的改善相关，但与HD其他运动特征的恶化相关。少动症在HD中逐渐加重，并与功能损害和整体衰退相关。因此，使用VMAT2i治疗HD运动特征应是一个细致的决策，需考虑其多方面影响。
